San Angel Inn Restaurante.note: The Berry Grateful Margarita is a creator reported seasonal special. It does not appear on Disney's published San Angel Inn menu or on Disney Parks Blog foodie guides for 2026. No official Walt Disney World or freely licensed photo of that exact drink was found. A photo of a different San Angel margarita would be the wrong drink, so this pick stays empty until an official still of the Berry Grateful Margarita is available.

The Cookie Bar at Summer House on the La.note: The Warm Cookie Dough Scoop Sundae is not on the official Cookie Bar menu page. Summer House's own Disney Springs page embeds the restaurant's reel of the exact sundae (instagram.com/reel/DfiSeyMMuAO/). The only still from that embed is a 582 by 1032 portrait frame, too small and too tall to make a sharp 1280 by 853 card without heavy upscaling. No higher resolution official still was found on the restaurant site, Disney Parks Blog, or a free license source. An empty slot beats an upscaled or wrongly cropped frame.
